Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODCanvas

SetOwner

The SetOwner method assigns the specified owning part to this canvas. 
void SetOwner (in ODPart owner);
owner
A reference to the owning part to assign to this canvas.
DISCUSSION
You typically call this method immediately after your part creates a custom canvas.

SEE ALSO
The ODCanvas::AcquireOwner method (page 67).
"Adding and Removing Canvases" on page 133 in OpenDoc Programmer's Guide.
